div.head: Leis Wl 46
div.ab: Nus ne semble pas raisoun que l'um face pruvance sur testimonie ki conussent ço que entercé est, e que nul nel prust devant le terme de VI meis aprés iço que l'aveir [f]u emblé.

We regard it as unjust that a man should claim ownership against the witness of those who recognise the thing vouched to warranty. No-one shall claim ownership in less than six months from the time that the livestock was stolen.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 272–273 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
